about:
Electronic Components & Services Inc. (EC&S) has operated from Fox Lake, Wisconsin since its founding in 1978. The company began as a printed circuit board manufacturer and has remained at the same location on Industrial Drive.

EC&S fabricates single-sided, double-sided, and multilayer PCBs. It runs two production tracks: quick-turn prototypes in small quantities, and larger production orders that can be sourced domestically or offshore. The company accepts online orders for prototypes that include tooling and test, and provides customized quotes for specific material and finish requirements.

The company serves customers in competitive electronics industries, though no specific sectors are named in its public materials. Its client base includes businesses that require prototype and production PCB quantities.

EC&S states that its differentiation lies in a commitment to customer service, product quality, and on-time delivery, aiming to manufacture the finest quality PCBs in the fastest time possible.
